## Loaded matrices

```{r}
multi_omics_raw <- readRDS(paste0(params$output_dir, "Multi_Omics_Analysis_exp_lima.rds"))
```

## Metalomics correlation with the diet

```{r}
omic_dt <- multi_omics_full

diet_metals <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("../../inputs/Metallomics/metallomics_raw.xlsx",
                                    sheet = "diets", rowNames = TRUE)
rownames(diet_metals) <- gsub("CTR", "CNT", rownames(diet_metals))

dt_metals <- experiments(omic_dt[,,c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver")])
```


```{r}
lapply(names(dt_metals), function(organ_name){
    organ_dt <- dt_metals[[organ_name]]    
    lapply(rownames(organ_dt), function(var_name){
        plot_dt <- data.frame("Intensity" = as.numeric(assay(organ_dt[var_name,])), 
                            "group" = organ_dt$group)
        ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = group, y = Intensity, fill = group)) + 
            geom_boxplot() + ggtitle(paste(organ_name, var_name)) + 
            theme_minimal()
    })
})
```


```{r}
cor_mat <- lapply(dt_metals, function(exp_dt){
    diet_metals_long <- diet_metals[as.character(exp_dt$group), rownames(exp_dt)]
    # plotly::plot_ly(z = cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long))
    return(diag(cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long)))
})
names(cor_mat) <- names(dt_metals)
cor_dt <- lapply(names(cor_mat), function(x){
    data.frame("cor" = abs(cor_mat[[x]]), "organ" = x)
})
cor_dt <- do.call(rbind, cor_dt)

pdf(paste0(params$output_dir, "diet_metals_correlations_boxplot.pdf"))
boxplot(cor ~ organ, cor_dt)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
multi_omics <- multi_omics_full
filtered_exps <- lapply(names(multi_omics_full), function(multi_omics_names){
    multi_omics_exp <- experiments(multi_omics_full)[[multi_omics_names]]
    p_val_dt <- rowData(multi_omics_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value", colnames(rowData(multi_omics_exp)))]
    p_val_dt <- p_val_dt[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt))]
    multi_omics_exp <- multi_omics_exp[apply(as.matrix(p_val_dt) <= 0.05, 1, any),]
    
    # if(nrow(multi_omics_exp) == 0){return(NA)}
    
    multi_omics_exp
})
names(filtered_exps) <- names(multi_omics)
filtered_exps[is.na(filtered_exps)] <- NULL

experiments(multi_omics) <- ExperimentList(filtered_exps)
multi_omics_selected <- multi_omics_selected[multi_omics_selected %in% names(multi_omics)]
```

```{r}
omic_names_dict <- c("Liver RNA Sequencing", "Liver DNA Methylation",

group_color_dict <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(levels(droplevels(multi_omics$group))),
```

```{r}
omic_names_dup <- sapply(strsplit(multi_omics_ordered, "\\."), 
                        function(x){x[[1]]})
omic_names_dup[grep("cogs", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "cogs"
omic_names_dup[grep("EC", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "EC"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_kegg", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_kegg"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_pathway", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_pathway"

names(omic_names_dup) <- multi_omics_ordered

unique_omics <- unique(omic_names_dup)

omic_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(unique_omics), name = "Set3")


col_list <- lapply(seq_along(unique_omics), function(omic_id){
    omic_name <- unique_omics[omic_id]
    
    colors_found <- names(omic_names_dup)[omic_names_dup == omic_name]
    
    omic_num <- length(colors_found)
    omic_col <- omic_colors[omic_id]
    
    col_ramp <- colorRampPalette(colors = c(omic_col, "white"))(omic_num + 1)[seq_len(omic_num)]
    names(col_ramp) <- colors_found
    return(col_ramp)
})

color_vect <- unlist(col_list)
omic_color_dict <- color_vect
```

## Enrich information

```{r}
# omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
# ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", "entrezID", "geneId")

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                 "RNA_Sequencing", 
                 "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", 
                      "entrezID", "geneId")

library(SummarizedExperiment)

## Enrich IDs dictionary
omic_dict_list <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
    
    omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
    omic_dict <- strsplit(rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]], ";")
    
    names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
    
    omic_dict
    
}, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)

rna_seq_rd <- lapply(experiments(omic_dt)[omic_enrich], rowData)
num_factors <- 2
## Universe IDs mapped
universe_list_ids <- lapply(names(rna_seq_rd), function(omic_name){
    omic_ids <- omic_dict_list[[omic_name]][paste0(omic_name, ".", rownames(rna_seq_rd[[omic_name]]))]
    omic_ids <- omic_ids[!is.null(omic_ids)]
    omic_ids <- unlist(omic_ids)
    omic_ids[!is.na(omic_ids)]

})
names(universe_list_ids) <- names(rna_seq_rd)
```


```{r}
## ORA IDs
clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    omic_names <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "WGB_DNA_Methylation", "RNA_Sequencing")
    clu_ids <- lapply(omic_names, function(omic_id){
        omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_id]]
        features_factor <- rownames(rowData(omic_exp))[rowData(omic_exp)[[paste0("Factor_", 
                                                            factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]]
        paste0(omic_id, ".", features_factor)
    })
    names(clu_ids) <- omic_names
    
    metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][clu_ids$Untargeted_Metabolomics]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]

    wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][clu_ids$WGB_DNA_Methylation]
    wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
    
    rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][clu_ids$RNA_Sequencing]
    rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
    
    return(list(
        "Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt,
        "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt, 
        "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
})
names(clu_ids_enrich) <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))
```

```{r}
## GSEA FCs
col_names <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics",
                "RNA_Sequencing",
                "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged",
                      "entrezID", "geneId")

fc_dict <- lapply(col_names, function(col_name){
    col_name <- paste0(col_name, "_weights")
    # 
    omic_fc_dict <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
        omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
        omic_dict <- rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]]
        
        fc_dt <- rowData(omic_data)[[col_name]]
        
        names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
        
        omic_fc <- mapply(function(var_names, fc_vect){
            var_names_split <- strsplit(var_names, ";")[[1]]
            var_names_split <- var_names_split[!is.na(var_names_split)]
            if(!length(var_names_split)){return(NULL)}
            fc_vect_dict <- rep(fc_vect, length(var_names_split))
            names(fc_vect_dict) <- var_names_split
            fc_vect_dict
        }, var_names = omic_dict, fc_vect = fc_dt, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        
        unlist(omic_fc)
    }, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)
    
    omic_fc_dict
})
names(fc_dict) <- col_names
```

## Gene analysis

```{r}
exp_id <- "RNA_Sequencing"

dt_exp <- multi_omics[[exp_id]]
dt_exp_raw <- multi_omics_raw[[exp_id]]
dt_exp_raw <- dt_exp_raw[,dt_exp_raw$group != "HFE"]
```

```{r}
p_val_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value",
                                colnames(rowData(dt_exp)))]
p_val_dt_g <- p_val_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt_g))]

fc_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp)[,grepl("FC",
                                colnames(rowData(dt_exp)))]
fc_dt_g <- fc_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(fc_dt_g))]

p_val_sum <- lapply(p_val_dt_g, function(x){
    sum(x <= 0.05)
})

fc_dir <- lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    fc_dir <- ifelse(sig_vars <= 0, "Down-regulated", "Up-regulated")
    table(fc_dir)
})
names(fc_dir) <- names(fc_dt_g)
fc_dir

fc_dir


lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    summary(abs(sig_vars))
})


comp_dt <- lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    summary(sig_vars)
    data.frame("fc" = sig_vars, "comparison" = names(fc_dt_g)[[x_id]])
})
comp_dt <- do.call(rbind, comp_dt)
ggplot(comp_dt) + geom_histogram(aes(x = abs(fc), fill = comparison), bins = 60) +
    theme_minimal()

tapply(abs(comp_dt$fc), INDEX = comp_dt$comparison, summary)
```

```{r}
## Variable variance tests
library(DESeq2)
dt_exp_raw_DESeq <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = assay(dt_exp_raw),
                                      colData = colData(dt_exp_raw),
                                      design= ~ 0 + group)
dt_exp_raw_DESeq <- estimateSizeFactors(dt_exp_raw_DESeq)
normalized_counts <- counts(dt_exp_raw_DESeq, normalized = TRUE)

## Without filtering
group_sds <- lapply(levels(dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group), function(x){
    group_dt <- normalized_counts[,dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group == x]
    data.frame("sd" = rowSds(as.matrix(assay(group_dt))), "group" = x)
})
group_sds <- do.call(rbind, group_sds)

ggplot(group_sds) + geom_density(aes(x = log(sd), fill = group))

                        method = "fdr", alternative = "two.sided")
```

### Correlations Genes-Associated DMRS

```{r}
rna_seq_dt_found <- rna_seq_dt[rownames(rna_seq_dt) %in% rowData(dna_met_dt)$ensemblId,]
rna_seq_dt_found

overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_seq_dt), colnames(dna_met_dt))
overlap_samples

gene_dmr_cors_list <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
    corr_dt <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt_found), function(x){

        rna_seq_gene <- rna_seq_dt_found[x, overlap_samples]
        dna_met_dmr <- dna_met_dt[!is.na(rowData(dna_met_dt)$ensemblId) & 
                                    rowData(dna_met_dt)$ensemblId %in% x, overlap_samples]
        mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = rna_seq_gene, 
                                            experiment2 = dna_met_dmr,
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE)

    })
    corr_dt <- do.call(rbind, corr_dt)
    corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
    corr_dt
})
names(gene_dmr_cors_list) <- corr_methods

saveRDS(gene_dmr_cors_list, paste0(corr_output_dir, "sig_genes_own_dmr_corr.rds"))
```


```{r}

colnames(rowData(dna_met_dt))

gene_dmr_cors_list <- lapply(names(gene_dmr_cors_list), function(cor_id){
    gene_dmr_cors <- gene_dmr_cors_list[[cor_id]]
    gene_dmr_cors <- gene_dmr_cors[gene_dmr_cors$p_adj <= 0.05,]
    gene_dmr_cors$isNeg <- ifelse(gene_dmr_cors$cor <= 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    gene_dmr_cors$type <- cor_id
    gene_dmr_cors$DMR_annotation <- simplified_DMR_annotation[as.character(gene_dmr_cors$Var2)]
    gene_dmr_cors
})
names(gene_dmr_cors_list) <- corr_methods
```

```{r}
rna_seq_dt_found <- rna_seq_all[rownames(rna_seq_all) %in%
                                    rowData(dna_met_dt)$ensemblId,]
rna_seq_dt_found

overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_seq_all), colnames(dna_met_dt))
overlap_samples

all_gene_dmr_cors_list <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
    corr_dt <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt_found), function(x){
        rna_seq_gene <- rna_seq_dt_found[x, overlap_samples]
        dna_met_dmr <- dna_met_dt[!is.na(rowData(dna_met_dt)$ensemblId) & 
                                    rowData(dna_met_dt)$ensemblId %in% x, overlap_samples]
        mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = rna_seq_gene, 
                                            experiment2 = dna_met_dmr,
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE)

    })
    corr_dt <- do.call(rbind, corr_dt)
    corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
    corr_dt
})
names(all_gene_dmr_cors_list) <- corr_methods

saveRDS(all_gene_dmr_cors_list, paste0(corr_output_dir, "all_genes_own_dmr_corr.rds"))
```

```{r}
dmr_gene_corr_dt <- readRDS("../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/gene_tf_histone_analysis/sig_genes_dmr_corr.rds")

dmr2ensembl <- rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])$ensemblId
names(dmr2ensembl) <- rownames(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])

ensembl_2_chr_dmr <- paste0("Chr", rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])$geneChr)
names(ensembl_2_chr_dmr) <- rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])$ensemblId

ensembl_2_chr_gene <- paste0("Chr", rowData(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$chromosome_name) 
names(ensembl_2_chr_gene) <- rownames(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])
ensembl_2_chr <- c(ensembl_2_chr_dmr, ensembl_2_chr_gene)

ensembl_2_chr <- ensembl_2_chr[!duplicated(names(ensembl_2_chr))]
ensembl_2_chr <- ensembl_2_chr[!ensembl_2_chr %in% c("ChrGL456233.1", "ChrNA")]

# dmr_2_tssdist <- rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])$distanceToTSS
# names(dmr_2_tssdist) <- rownames(rowData(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]))

ensembl_2_start <- rowData(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$start_position
names(ensembl_2_start) <- rownames(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])

dmr_2_start <- start(rowRanges(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]))
names(dmr_2_start) <- rownames(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])

dmr_2_end <- end(rowRanges(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]))
names(dmr_2_end) <- rownames(multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]])


dmr_gene_corr_dt <- lapply(dmr_gene_corr_dt, function(score_dt){
    
    score_dt$DMR_ensembl <- dmr2ensembl[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]
    score_dt$Own_DMR <- !is.na(score_dt$DMR_ensembl) & (score_dt$DMR_ensembl == score_dt$Var1)
    
    score_dt$DMR_region <- simplified_DMR_annotation[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]
    
    score_dt$Gene_chr <- ensembl_2_chr[as.character(score_dt$Var1)]
    score_dt$DMR_chr <- ensembl_2_chr[as.character(score_dt$DMR_ensembl)]
    score_dt$sig_corr <- abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.6 & score_dt$p_adj <= 0.05
    # score_dt$DMR_tss <- dmr_2_tssdist[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]
    score_dt$Own_chr <- !is.na(score_dt$Gene_chr) & !is.na(score_dt$DMR_chr) & (score_dt$Gene_chr == score_dt$DMR_chr) 
    
    dist_to_start <- abs(as.numeric(ensembl_2_start[as.character(score_dt$Var1)]) - as.numeric(dmr_2_start[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]))
    dist_to_end <- abs(as.numeric(ensembl_2_start[as.character(score_dt$Var1)]) - as.numeric(dmr_2_end[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]))
    
    score_dt$dist_to_tss <- apply(cbind(dist_to_start, dist_to_end), 1, min)
    score_dt$corr_type <- cut(abs(score_dt$cor), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), 
                             labels = c("Very Low","Low", "Medium", 
                                        "High", "Very High"))
    
    score_dt
})

# dmr_gene_corr_dt_filt <- lapply(dmr_gene_corr_dt, function(score_dt){
#     score_dt[score_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]    
# })
dmr_gene_corr_dt_filt <- lapply(dmr_gene_corr_dt, function(score_dt){
    score_dt[abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.6 & score_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]    
})

dmr_gene_corr_dt_chr <- lapply(dmr_gene_corr_dt, function(score_dt){
    score_dt[abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.6 & score_dt$p_adj <= 0.05 & score_dt$Own_chr,]
})

dmr_gene_corr_dt_chr_1MB <- lapply(dmr_gene_corr_dt, function(score_dt){
    score_dt[abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.6 & score_dt$p_adj <= 0.05 &
                 score_dt$Own_chr & score_dt$dist_to_tss < 1e6,]
})

dmr_gene_corr_dt_filt_08 <- lapply(dmr_gene_corr_dt, function(score_dt){
    score_dt[abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.8 & score_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]    
})
```

#### Distal same chromosome Positive & Negative correlations

```{r}
pos_neg_corr_info <- lapply(names(dmr_gene_corr_dt_chr), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- dmr_gene_corr_dt_chr[[score_id]]
    
    plot_dt1 <- data.frame("Var_ID" = levels(score_dt$Var1),
                        "Num_Correlations" = tapply(X = score_dt$cor, 
       score_dt$Var1, length),
                        "Positive_Correlations" = tapply(X = score_dt$cor, 
       score_dt$Var1, function(x){sum(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE)}),
                        "Negative_Correlations" = tapply(X = score_dt$cor, 
       score_dt$Var1, function(x){sum(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE)})*-1,
                        "Group" = "Number of DMRs a gene regulates")
    
    plot_dt1$Var_ID <- factor(x = plot_dt1$Var_ID, levels = plot_dt1$Var_ID[order(plot_dt1$Positive_Correlations, decreasing = FALSE)])
    
    plot_dt1 <- reshape2::melt(plot_dt1, 
                                measure.vars = c("Positive_Correlations", 
                                                "Negative_Correlations"),
                                value.name = "Correlations")
    
    plot_dt1$Var_ID <- droplevels(plot_dt1$Var_ID)
    plot_dt1 <- plot_dt1[!is.na(plot_dt1$Num_Correlations),]
    
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt1) + 
            geom_col(aes(x = Correlations, y = Var_ID, fill = variable))+
            theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank()) + 
            xlab("Number of DMRs that regulate a gene") + ylab("Genes") + 
            ggtitle(paste(score_id, "correlations"))
    print(p1)
    return(plot_dt1)
})
```

```{r}
test_list <- tapply(X = dmr_gene_corr_dt_chr$pearson$cor, INDEX = dmr_gene_corr_dt_chr$pearson$Var1, function(x){
    corr_vals <- factor(x > 0, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
                        labels = c("Negative Corr", "Positive Corr"))
    p_vals <- chisq.test(x = table(corr_vals), p = c(0.5, 0.5))$p.value
    
    pos_prop <- prop.table(table(corr_vals))
    data.frame("p.val" = p_vals, "prop_diff_abs" = abs(pos_prop[2] - pos_prop[1]),
               "prop_diff" = pos_prop[2] - pos_prop[1], 
               "which_max" = names(pos_prop)[which.max(pos_prop)], "ncor" = length(x))
})
test_list <- do.call(rbind, test_list)
test_list$adj.p.val <- p.adjust(test_list$p.val, method = "bonferroni")
test_list <- test_list[test_list$adj.p.val <= 0.05,]
sum(test_list$adj.p.val <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

table(test_list$which_max)

```

```{r}
pos_neg_genes_chr <- tapply(rownames(test_list), test_list$which_max, function(x){return(x)})
```

```{r}
})
```

```{r}
dmrreg_go_enrich <- lapply(gene_id_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = weight_dt, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "ALL", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
        
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

### Gene-1MB dmr correlations

```{r}
rna_seq_dt_clean <- rna_seq_dt[!is.na(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position),]

overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_seq_dt_clean), colnames(dna_met_dt))
overlap_samples

rna_seq_rr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = rowData(rna_seq_dt_clean)$chromosome_id,
    ranges = IRanges(start = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_dt_clean)$start_position) - 1e6,
    end = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_dt_clean)$start_position) + 1e6,
    names = rownames(rna_seq_dt_clean)))

dna_met_dt_1mb <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt_clean), function(gene_id){
    ov_dt <- findOverlaps(query = rowRanges(dna_met_dt), subject = rna_seq_rr[gene_id,])
    dna_met_dt[ov_dt@from,]
})
names(dna_met_dt_1mb) <- rownames(rna_seq_dt_clean)
```


```{r}
sig_gene_1MB_dmr_cors_list <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
    corr_list_res <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt_clean), function(gene_id){
        print(gene_id)
        dna_met_found <- dna_met_dt_1mb[[gene_id]]
        if(!nrow(dna_met_found)){return(NULL)}
            corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(
                x = rna_seq_dt_clean[gene_id, overlap_samples],
                experiment2 = dna_met_found[,overlap_samples],
                method = corr_name,
                assay.type1 = "dt1",
                assay.type2 = "dt1",
                test_significance = TRUE, 
                show_warnings = FALSE, 
                verbose = FALSE)
        corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
        corr_dt
    })
    corr_list_res <- do.call(rbind, corr_list_res)
    corr_list_res$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(corr_list_res$p_adj, "fdr")
    corr_list_res
})

names(sig_gene_1MB_dmr_cors_list) <- corr_methods

saveRDS(sig_gene_1MB_dmr_cors_list, 
        paste0(corr_output_dir, "sig_genes_1MB_dmr_corr.rds"))
```

#### Correlation with transcriptomics

```{r}
corr_vect <- c("pearson", "spearman")

list_overlaps <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt), function(gene_id){
    gene_rd <- rowData(rna_seq_dt[gene_id,])
    
    start_gene <- as.numeric(gene_rd$start_position) - 1000000
    end_gene <- as.numeric(gene_rd$end_position) + 1000000
    
    if(!is.na(start_gene)){
        chr_id <- gene_rd$chromosome_id
        chr_dmrs_id <- as.character(seqnames(rowRanges(reg_elements_exp_filt)))
        
        gene_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = chr_id, ranges = IRanges(start = start_gene, 
                                                               end = end_gene))
        
        chr_dmrs <- reg_elements_exp_filt[chr_dmrs_id == chr_id,]
    
        dmr_overlap <- findOverlaps(query = gene_gr, rowRanges(chr_dmrs), type = "any")
        chr_dmrs[dmr_overlap@to,]    
    } else{
        return(reg_elements_exp_filt[rowData(reg_elements_exp_filt)$ensemblId       %in%
                                                gene_id,])    
    }
})
names(list_overlaps) <- rownames(rna_seq_dt)

intersect_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_seq_dt),
                               colnames(reg_elements_exp_filt))

assayNames(rna_seq_dt) <- "dt1"
corr_vect <- c("pearson", "spearman")

corr_dt_list_reg_regions_2 <- lapply(corr_vect, function(corr_name){
    
    list_prom <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt), function(gene_id){
        rna_seq_gene <- rna_seq_dt[gene_id,]
        
        own_dmrs <- list_overlaps[[gene_id]]
        # entrez_id <- rownames(rna_seq_gene)
        # if(is.na(entrez_id)){return(NULL)}
        
        if(!nrow(own_dmrs)){return(NULL)}
        
        mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = rna_seq_gene[,intersect_samples], 
                                            experiment2 = own_dmrs[,intersect_samples],
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE, 
                                            verbose = FALSE)
    })
    do.call(rbind, list_prom)
})

corr_dt_list_reg_regions_2 <- lapply(corr_dt_list_reg_regions_2, function(x){
    x$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(x$pval, "fdr")
    x
})
names(corr_dt_list_reg_regions_2) <- corr_vect

saveRDS(corr_dt_list_reg_regions_2, "../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/test_reg_regions_1MB_cors_lima.rds")
```

```{r}
reg_elements_cor <- readRDS("../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/test_reg_regions_1MB_cors_lima.rds")

ensembl_2_start <- rowData(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$start_position
names(ensembl_2_start) <- rownames(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])

dmr_2_start <- start(rowRanges(reg_elements_exp_filt))
names(dmr_2_start) <- rownames(reg_elements_exp_filt)

dmr_2_end <- end(rowRanges(reg_elements_exp_filt))
names(dmr_2_end) <- rownames(reg_elements_exp_filt)

ensembl_2_chr_gene <- paste0("Chr", rowData(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$chromosome_name) 
names(ensembl_2_chr_gene) <- rownames(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]])

dmr2ensembl <- rowData(reg_elements_exp)$ensemblId
names(dmr2ensembl) <- rownames(reg_elements_exp)

dmr2type <- rowData(reg_elements_exp)$type
names(dmr2type) <- rownames(reg_elements_exp)

reg_elements_cor <- lapply(reg_elements_cor, function(score_dt){
    gene_tss <- as.numeric(ensembl_2_start[as.character(score_dt$Var1)])
    dmrs_start <- as.numeric(dmr_2_start[as.character(score_dt$Var2)])
    dmrs_end <- as.numeric(dmr_2_end[as.character(score_dt$Var2)])
    tss_dist_dt <- data.frame("start_dist" = abs(gene_tss - dmrs_start), 
                            "end_dist" = abs(gene_tss - dmrs_end))
    score_dt$tss_dist <- apply(tss_dist_dt, 1, min)
    score_dt$DMR_ensembl <- dmr2ensembl[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]
    
    score_dt$own_dmr <- !is.na(score_dt$DMR_ensembl) & score_dt$Var1 == score_dt$DMR_ensembl
    score_dt$dmr_type <- dmr2type[as.character(score_dt$Var2)]
    score_dt
    
})

reg_elements_cor_filt <- lapply(reg_elements_cor, function(score_dt){
    score_dt[score_dt$adj.p.value <= 0.05 & abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.6,]
})

prop.table(table(reg_elements_cor$pearson$own_dmr,
                reg_elements_cor$pearson$dmr_type), margin = 1)

prop.table(table(reg_elements_cor$pearson$own_dmr,
                reg_elements_cor$pearson$cor > 0), margin = 1)

cor(abs(reg_elements_cor$pearson$cor), 
        reg_elements_cor$pearson$tss_dist, use = "complete.obs")

cor.test(abs(reg_elements_cor_filt$pearson$cor), 
        reg_elements_cor_filt$pearson$tss_dist, use = "complete.obs")

```

##### GO enrich

```{r}
mb1_dmrreg_go_enrich <- lapply(dmr_reg_1MB_genes, function(factor_dt){
    enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = as.character(factor_dt), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                            keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                            ont = "ALL", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                            universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
    enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
    
    enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
    enrich_res
})

```

##### KEGG enrich

```{r}
mb1_dmrreg_kegg_enrich <- lapply(dmr_reg_1MB_genes, function(factor_dt){
    entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(factor_dt), 
                         column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                            TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                            TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                            universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
    if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
    enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
    enrich_res
})
```


##### Chebi enrich 

```{r}
mb1_dmrreg_chebi_enrich <- lapply(dmr_reg_1MB_genes, function(factor_dt){
    symbol_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(factor_dt), 
                         column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
    
    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = symbol_ids, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
            pAdjustMethod = "fdr", TERM2GENE = term2gene_filt, TERM2NAME = term2name_filt,
            universe = NULL, maxGSSize = Inf)
    enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
    enrich_res
})
```

### Correlations Genes-TF


```{r}
table(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$gene_biotype)

proc_biotype <- sapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt), function(gene_id){
    gene_type <- rowData(rna_seq_dt[gene_id,])$gene_biotype
    
    if(grepl("pseudogene", gene_type)){return("Pseudogenes")
    } else if(is.na(gene_type) | grepl("TEC|_gene$", gene_type)){return("Other genes/Unknown")
    } else if(grepl("protein_coding", gene_type)){
        if(gene_id %in% rownames(tf_genes)){return("Protein TF")} else{
            return("Protein Coding")    
        }
    } else if(grepl("lncRNA", gene_type)){return("lncRNA")
    } else if(grepl("RNA", gene_type)){return("Other RNAs")
    } else{return(gene_type)}
})
plot_dt <- data.frame("Gene_Type" = proc_biotype, 
                    "DMR_Regulated" = ifelse(rownames(rna_seq_dt) %in% dmr_regulated, 
                                            "Yes", "No"))

p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt) + geom_bar(aes(x = DMR_Regulated, fill = Gene_Type), width = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal() + labs(fill = "Gene Type") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", x = c("No", "Yes"), y = max(table(plot_dt$DMR_Regulated))+200, 
             label = tapply(plot_dt$Gene_Type, INDEX = plot_dt$DMR_Regulated, FUN = length)) +
    xlab("DMR Regulated") + ylab("Counts") + theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1")
p1
ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "figure_8_a.svg"), plot = p1, 
        fix_text_size = FALSE)
ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "figure_8_a.png"), plot = p1)


p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt) + geom_bar(aes(x = DMR_Regulated, fill = Gene_Type), width = 0.4, 
                                position = "fill") + theme_minimal() + 
    xlab("DMR Regulated") + ylab("Proportions") + labs(fill = "Gene Type") + 
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", x = c("No", "Yes"), y = 1.05,
```

```{r}
    genes_tf_cor <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = rna_seq_dt, 
                                                        experiment2 = tf_genes,
                                                        method = corr_name,
                                                        assay.type1 = "dt1",

                                                        test_significance =  TRUE)

})
names(genes_tf_cor_list) <- corr_methods
saveRDS(genes_tf_cor_list, paste0(corr_output_dir, "genes_tf_corr.rds"))
```

```{r}
genes_tf_cor_list <- readRDS(paste0(corr_output_dir, "genes_tf_corr.rds"))

genes_tf_cor_list_all <- genes_tf_cor_list

genes_tf_cor_list <- lapply(names(genes_tf_cor_list), function(corr_id){
    genes_tf_cor <- genes_tf_cor_list[[corr_id]]
    
    genes_tf_cor <- genes_tf_cor[genes_tf_cor$p_adj <= 0.05,]    
    genes_tf_cor <- genes_tf_cor[as.character(genes_tf_cor$Var1) != as.character(genes_tf_cor$Var2),]
    genes_tf_cor$isNeg <- ifelse(genes_tf_cor$cor <= 0, "Negative", "Positive")

    genes_tf_cor$gene_dmrReg <- ifelse(genes_tf_cor$Var1 %in%
                                        gene_dmr_cors_list[[corr_id]]$Var1, 
                                       "Yes", "No")
    genes_tf_cor$tf_dmrReg <- ifelse(genes_tf_cor$Var2 %in%
                                        gene_dmr_cors_list[[corr_id]]$Var1, 
                                    "Yes", "No")
    
    genes_tf_cor
})

names(genes_tf_cor_list) <- names(genes_tf_cor_list_all)

tf_associated <- lapply(genes_tf_cor_list, function(genes_tf_cor){
    tf_associated <- tapply(genes_tf_cor$Var2, 
                        INDEX = genes_tf_cor$Var1, 
                        FUN = function(x){x})
    tf_associated[lengths(tf_associated) != 0]
})
```

```{r}
## Testing if genes at larger distances have also lower FCs
for(corr_id in corr_methods){
    test_dist <- igraph::distances(graph = tf_nw_tplink_test, 
                                    v = V(tf_nw_tplink_test)[vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "dmrREG.spearman") &
                                                                vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "isTF")], 
                                    mode = "out")
    
    
    nw_attr <- vertex.attributes(graph = tf_nw_tplink_test)[c("HFD-CNT.log2FC", 
                                                            "INT-CNT.log2FC",  
                                                            "INT-HFD.log2FC")]
    nw_attr <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,nw_attr))
    nw_attr$dist_dt <- apply(test_dist, 2, min)
    
    rownames(nw_attr) <- names(V(tf_nw_tplink_test))
    nw_attr <- nw_attr[!(rownames(nw_attr) %in% names(V(tf_nw_tplink_test))[!vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, 
                                                                                        paste0("dmrREG.",
                                                                                                corr_id)) &
                                                                                !vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "isTF")]),]
    
    for(fc_id in names(nw_attr)[1:3]){
        
        print(tapply(abs(nw_attr[[fc_id]]), nw_attr$dist_dt, summary))
        
        print(ggplot(nw_attr) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = as.factor(dist_dt), 
                                     y = abs(.data[[fc_id]]))))
    }
    
    nw_attr$total_fc <- abs(nw_attr$`HFD-CNT.log2FC`) + abs(nw_attr$`INT-HFD.log2FC`)
    
    print(tapply(abs(nw_attr[["total_fc"]]), nw_attr$dist_dt, summary))
    
    print(ggplot(nw_attr) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = as.factor(dist_dt), 
                                     y = abs(.data[["total_fc"]]))))
}
```

```{r}
long_dt <- as_adjacency_matrix(tf_nw_tplink_test, attr = "spearman")
long_dt <- long_dt[names(V(tf_nw_tplink_test))[vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "dmrREG.spearman") &
                                                            vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "isTF")],]
dist_mat <- distances(tf_nw_tplink_test, 
                        v = V(tf_nw_tplink_test)[vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "dmrREG.spearman") &
                                                            vertex_attr(tf_nw_tplink_test, "isTF")],
                        mode = "out")

corr_info <- lapply(colnames(long_dt), function(nw_id){
    dist_id <- which.min(dist_mat[,nw_id])
    corr_dt <- long_dt[dist_id, nw_id]
    data.frame("Distance" = min(dist_mat[,nw_id]),
               "Correlation" = corr_dt)
})
corr_info <- do.call(rbind, corr_info)

ggplot(corr_info) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = as.factor(Distance), 
                                 y = abs(.data[["Correlation"]])))
```

```{r}
genes_histone_cor_list <- readRDS(paste0(corr_output_dir, "genes_histone_corr.rds"))
genes_histone_cor_list_all <- genes_histone_cor_list

residues_dict <- rowData(histone_dt)$Histone_Residues_K
names(residues_dict) <- rownames(histone_dt)
    
genes_histone_cor_list <- lapply(names(genes_histone_cor_list), function(corr_id){
    genes_histone_cor <- genes_histone_cor_list[[corr_id]]
    genes_histone_cor <- genes_histone_cor[genes_histone_cor$p_adj <= 0.05 & abs(genes_histone_cor$cor) > 0.8,]
    genes_histone_cor$isNeg <- ifelse(genes_histone_cor$cor <= 0, "Negative", "Positive")

    genes_histone_cor$gene_dmrReg <- ifelse(genes_histone_cor$Var1 %in%
                                            gene_dmr_cors_list[[corr_id]]$Var1, 
                                       "Yes", "No")
    genes_histone_cor$tf_dmrReg <- ifelse(genes_histone_cor$Var2 %in%
                                            gene_dmr_cors_list[[corr_id]]$Var1, 
                                    "Yes", "No")
    genes_histone_cor$residue_K <- residues_dict[as.character(genes_histone_cor$Var2)]
        
    genes_histone_cor
})
names(genes_histone_cor_list) <- names(genes_histone_cor_list_all)

histone_associated <- lapply(genes_histone_cor_list, function(genes_histone_cor){
    histone_associated <- tapply(genes_histone_cor$Var2, 
                        INDEX = genes_histone_cor$Var1, 
                        function(x){x})
    histone_associated[lengths(histone_associated) != 0]
})

pearson_histone_reg <- unique(genes_histone_cor_list$pearson$Var1)
spearman_histone_reg <- unique(genes_histone_cor_list$spearman$Var1)
```

```{r}
num_dt_list <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_id){
    corr_dt <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_dt), function(ensembl_id){
        
        histone_ids <- histone_associated[[corr_id]][[ensembl_id]]
        tf_ids <- tf_associated[[corr_id]][[ensembl_id]]
        dmr_ids <- dmr_associated[[corr_id]][[ensembl_id]]
        tf_db_tplink_ids <- tf_db_associated_tflink[[corr_id]][[ensembl_id]]
        
        
        data.frame("Num_Histones" = length(histone_ids),
                   "Num_TF" = length(tf_ids),
                   "Num_DMRs" = length(dmr_ids),
                   "Any_DMRs" = length(dmr_ids) != 0,
                   "is_TF" = ensembl_id %in% rownames(tf_genes),
                   "Num_TF_DB_tplink" = length(tf_db_tplink_ids),
                   "Num_Histone_pc" = length(histone_ids)/nrow(histone_dt),
                   "Num_TF_pc" = length(tf_ids)/nrow(tf_genes)
                   # "Num_DMRs_pc" = length(dmr_ids),
                   # "Num_TF_DB_pc" = length(tf_db_ids)
                   )
    })
    corr_dt <- do.call(rbind, corr_dt)
    rownames(corr_dt) <- rownames(rna_seq_dt)
    corr_dt
})
names(num_dt_list) <- corr_methods
```


```{r}
overall_p <- function(my_model) {
    f <- summary(my_model)$fstatistic
    p <- pf(f[1],f[2],f[3],lower.tail=F)
    attributes(p) <- NULL
    return(p)
}


for(corr_id in names(num_dt_list)){
    num_dt <- num_dt_list[[corr_id]]
    num_dt <- cbind(num_dt, fc_dt_g)
    
    for(fc_ct_id in colnames(fc_dt_g[1:4])){
        print(paste0(fc_ct_id, " Num. histones"))
        print(cor.test(abs(fc_dt_g[[fc_ct_id]]), 
                       num_dt$Num_Histones))
        print(paste0(fc_ct_id, " Num. TFs"))
        print(cor.test(abs(fc_dt_g[[fc_ct_id]]), 
                       num_dt$Num_TF))
    }
    
    print(cor.test(num_dt$Num_Histones, num_dt$Num_TF))
    
    lm_mod <- lm(num_dt$Num_Histones ~ num_dt$Num_TF)
    lm_sum <- summary(lm_mod)
    
    print(lm_sum)
    
    test_mod <- paste0("y = ", round(lm_sum$coefficients[1,1], 2), " + ", 
                       round(lm_sum$coefficients[2,1], 3), "x \n R = ", round(lm_sum$adj.r.squared, 2), 
                       " / p-value = ", round(overall_p(lm_mod), 2)) 
    
    p1 <- ggplot(num_dt) + geom_point(aes(x = Num_Histones, y= Num_TF)) + 
            xlab("Number of histone correlations") + ylab("Number of TF correlations") + 
            theme_minimal() + ggtitle(paste(corr_id, "correlations")) + 
            geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(x = Num_Histones, y = Num_TF)) +
            annotate(geom = "text", x = 2, y = 200, label = test_mod)
    print(p1)
    ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "figure_10_", corr_id, ".svg"), 
            plot = p1,  fix_text_size = FALSE)
    ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "figure_10_", corr_id, ".png"), 
            plot = p1)
    
}
```

## Run MOFA2

We have a multi-omic dataset with over 35 datasets, including the different levels of hierarchy for the 16S and Shotgun Metagenomics and the different annotations for the functional metagenomics results.

We visualized the principal component analysis for each individual omic to have a vision of the data and select which datasets from the hierarchical levels and the functional metagenomics. With the results we choose to keep the Species hierarchy level and for the functional metagenomics the COGS and metaerg-kegg annotations.

We also applied a p-value threshold of 0.05 in any of the contrast to filter variables and match the results from the whole genome bisulphite that, because we used the DSS method that finds DMRs from clusters of statistically significant CpGs were already biased.

Thus, the MOFA model will help us find correlated feature patterns in the statistically significant data.

```{r}
                    args = list(input = "./MOFA_Models.Rmd",

                                                     param_list$results_name, ".html"), 
                                params = param_list
                            )
```

We can look at the resulting html file and we can the that all most of the variance for all the omics data is captured by the two first factors and the third one is biased towards the RNA-Seq. This makes sense because we have big differences in variable size between all the omics, this phenomena is difficult to avoid because we have many omics with very low values, even if we didn't apply a filter, thus, as the first two factors, surprisingly don't seem to be affected by this effect, and we have all the omics represented at least with a 20% of explained variance in these, we decided to proceed with it.

The factor boxplots show quite clearly two different patterns in the data, the first factor, represents features which change by the high fat diet (HFD) and are restored to similar levels by the intervention (INT); the second one shows features that are affected by HFD but the intervention fails to restore to control levels, keeping their levels changed.

Correlating these factors with the explained variance of each omic, we can see many omics biased towards one of both factors thus, we can propose that the liver histone hodifications, metallomics, targeted metabolomics and methylomics (WGB); serum targeted metabolomics and the cecum and colon functional metagenomics KEGG have a higher variance explained in the first factor thus, are the omics with the most significant features that are restored by the intervention and the cecum metallomics and targeted metabolomics are biased toward the second factor, thus they are changed by the HFD and kept mostly unchanged by the intervention.

These correlations with the first factor correlation reveal that epigenetic signatures, when affected by the high fat diet, are mostly restored to control levels after a life-style intervention, and the histone modifications and targeted metabolomics, which focused on epigenetically relevant metabolites.

All the remaining omics: the liver untargeted metabolomics, rna-sequencing and the colon and cecum metagenomics and functional clusters of orthologous groups of proteins, have even weights indicating that they contain features that can explain the variance in both factors.

Interestingly most of the metagenomics data, except the kegg functions show this pattern with the transcriptomics and untargeted metabolomics.

Looking at the weights of each feature in these factors we can see which of them are most important in explaining these patterns of the data. We looked at the absolute value distribution of weights for each omic and used as threshold for variable selection a percentage of features proportional to the variance explained of each omic in each factor.

We applied an overrepresentation analysis (ORA) to the significant genes and differentially methylated regions from each weight, dividing them into three subset: all the weights and dividing it into positive and negative weights.

##### GO enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_go_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = rownames(weight_dt), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "ALL", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
        
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res    
    })
})
```

##### KEGG enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_kegg_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                                TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```


##### Chebi enrich 

```{r}
mofa_factor_chebi_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        symbol_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = symbol_ids, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                pAdjustMethod = "fdr", TERM2GENE = term2gene_filt, TERM2NAME = term2name_filt,
                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = Inf)
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

#### DMR regulated enrich REG regions

```{r}
reg_elements_cor_filt <- lapply(reg_elements_cor, function(score_dt){
    score_dt[score_dt$adj.p.value <= 0.05 & abs(score_dt$cor) > 0.6,]
})

enrich_exp_list <- lapply(expr_list, function(factor_expr){
    range_dt <- rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$RNA_Sequencing)
    lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        range_dt <- range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                      envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]
        
        range_dt[rownames(range_dt) %in% reg_elements_cor_filt$pearson$Var1,]
    })
})
```

```{r}
overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(reg_elements_exp_filt),
                            colnames(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]]))
apply(f2_cors, 1, function(x){
    gene_dt <- multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]][x[["Var1"]], overlap_samples]
    dmr_dt <- reg_elements_exp_filt[x[["Var2"]], overlap_samples]
    v1 <- as.numeric(assay(gene_dt))
    v2 <- as.numeric(assay(dmr_dt))
    
    ggplot() + geom_point(aes(x = v1, y = v2, color = gene_dt$group)) + 
        xlab(x[["Var1"]]) + ylab(x[["Var2"]])
})
```

### Factor DMR-Gene overlap

```{r}
rna_seq_f2 <- multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]][f2_mofa_vars,]
rna_seq_f2 <- rna_seq_f2[!is.na(rowData(rna_seq_f2)$chromosome_id),]

dmr_met_f2 <- multi_omics[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][f2_mofa_vars_dmrs,]

rna_seq_rr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = rowData(rna_seq_f2)$chromosome_id,
    ranges = IRanges(start = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_f2)$start_position) - 1e6,
    end = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_f2)$start_position) + 1e6,
    names = rownames(rna_seq_f2)))

dna_met_dt_1mb <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_f2), function(gene_id){
    ov_dt <- findOverlaps(query = rowRanges(dmr_met_f2), subject = rna_seq_rr[gene_id,])
    found_dmrs <- rownames(dna_met_dt[ov_dt@from,])
    if(!length(found_dmrs)){return(NULL)}
    data.frame("DMR_ID" = found_dmrs, "Gene_ID" = gene_id)
})

names(dna_met_dt_1mb) <- rownames(rna_seq_f2)


dna_met_dt_1mb <- do.call(rbind, dna_met_dt_1mb)
length(unique(dna_met_dt_1mb$Gene_ID))
length(unique(dna_met_dt_1mb$DMR_ID))

length(f2_mofa_vars)

View(as.data.frame(rowData(dna_met_dt[unique(dna_met_dt_1mb$DMR_ID),])))
```

#### DMR regulated enrich MOFA factor 1MB

```{r}
enrich_exp_list <- lapply(expr_list, function(factor_expr){
    range_dt <- rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$RNA_Sequencing)
    lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        range_dt <- range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                      envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]
        if(grepl("1", expr_c)){
            return(range_dt[rownames(range_dt) %in% unique(dna_met_dt_1mb_full_f1$Gene_ID),])
        } else{
            return(range_dt[rownames(range_dt) %in% unique(dna_met_dt_1mb_full$Gene_ID),])    
        }
    })
})
```

```{r}
overlap_samples <- intersect(colnames(reg_elements_exp_filt),
                            colnames(multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]]))
apply(f2_cors, 1, function(x){
    gene_dt <- multi_omics[["RNA_Sequencing"]][x[["Var1"]], overlap_samples]
    dmr_dt <- reg_elements_exp_filt[x[["Var2"]], overlap_samples]
    v1 <- as.numeric(assay(gene_dt))
    v2 <- as.numeric(assay(dmr_dt))
    
    ggplot() + geom_point(aes(x = v1, y = v2, color = gene_dt$group)) + 
        xlab(x[["Var1"]]) + ylab(x[["Var2"]])
})
```

##### GO enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_go_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = rownames(weight_dt), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "ALL", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
        
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res    
    })
})
```

##### KEGG enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_kegg_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                                TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

### Data Heatmaps

```{r}
score_filt <- 0.9

weight_dt$which_max <- apply(weight_dt[1:2], 1, function(x){
    which.max(abs(x))    
})

plot_dt <- as.data.frame(table(weight_dt$omic_id, weight_dt$which_score))

ggplot(plot_dt) + geom_col(aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2))


weight_dt$which_score <- apply(weight_dt[1:2], 1, function(x){
    found <- which(abs(x)/sum(abs(x)) > score_filt)
    if(length(found)){
        return(found)
    } else{
        return(0)
    }
})

lapply(c(1,2), function(factor_id){
    multi_omics_vars <- multi_omics[rownames(weight_dt)[weight_dt$which_score == factor_id],,]
    multi_omics_vars <- multi_omics_vars[,,lengths(multi_omics_vars) != 0]

    # names(multi_omics_vars@ExperimentList$Untargeted_Metabolomics@assays) <- NULL

    heatmap_dt <- Reduce(f = combineRows, x = experiments(multi_omics_vars))
    assay(heatmap_dt)[is.na(assay(heatmap_dt))] <- 0

    heatMapFun(assay(heatmap_dt),
                    metadata = colData(heatmap_dt),
                    stratificationVar = "group",
                    cdQuantile = 0,  plot_name = paste("Factor", factor_id,
                                                       "variables", score_filt),
                    show_colnames = FALSE,
                    show_rownames = TRUE,
                    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean")
})

```

### Factor omic table

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))

factor_table <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    exp_table <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(exp_name){
        exp_dt <- experiments(omic_dt)[[exp_name]]
        
        table_dt <- data.frame("Freq" = sum(rowData(exp_dt)[[paste0("Factor_", factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]),
                                "Var1" = exp_name)
        
        table_dt$factor_id <- paste0("Factor ", factor_id)
        table_dt$omic_color <- omic_color_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)]
         
        table_dt$Var1 <- factor(omic_names_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)],
                                levels = omic_names_dict)
        table_dt
    })
    exp_table <- do.call(rbind, exp_table)
    exp_table$relFreq <- exp_table$Freq/sum(exp_table$Freq)
    exp_table
})
factor_table <- do.call(rbind, factor_table)
```

### Test correlations factor

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))
mofa_model <- MOFA2::load_model(file = paste0(output_dir, "model.hdf5"))

factor_dt <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list("dt1" = t(get_factors(mofa_model)$group1)))

overlap_samples_list <- lapply(experiments(omic_dt), function(x){
    intersect(colnames(factor_dt), colnames(x))
})

factor_exp_cors_list <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), 
                                 function(exp_name){
    overlap_samples_dt <- overlap_samples_list[[exp_name]]
    dt_exp <- omic_dt[[exp_name]]
    assayNames(dt_exp) <- "dt1"
    
    corr_res <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
        corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = factor_dt[,overlap_samples_dt], 
                                            experiment2 = dt_exp[,overlap_samples_dt],
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE)
        corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
        # colnames(corr_dt)[3] <- paste(corr_name, colnames(corr_dt)[3])
        corr_dt <- corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.7,]
        list("Factor_1" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor1",], 
            "Factor_2" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor2",])
    })
    names(corr_res) <- corr_methods
    corr_res
})
names(factor_exp_cors_list) <- names(experiments(omic_dt))

rna_seq_exp <- omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
corr_spearman_f1 <- as.character(factor_exp_cors_list$RNA_Sequencing$spearman$Factor_2$Var2)
corr_spearman_f2 <- as.character(factor_exp_cors_list$RNA_Sequencing$spearman$Factor_2$Var2)

corr_pearson_f1 <- as.character(factor_exp_cors_list$RNA_Sequencing$pearson$Factor_2$Var2)
corr_pearson_f2 <- as.character(factor_exp_cors_list$RNA_Sequencing$pearson$Factor_2$Var2)

pheatmap::pheatmap(as.matrix(assay(rna_seq_exp)[corr_spearman_f1,]), 
                   show_rownames = FALSE, 
                   annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(rna_seq_exp))[,"group", drop = FALSE])


pheatmap::pheatmap(as.matrix(assay(rna_seq_exp)[corr_spearman_f1,]), 
                   show_rownames = FALSE, 
                   annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(rna_seq_exp))[,"group", drop = FALSE])


pheatmap::pheatmap(as.matrix(assay(rna_seq_exp)[f1_mofa_vars[!f1_mofa_vars %in% corr_spearman_f1],]),
```

#### GO Enrich

```{r}
test_enrich_list <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = rownames(weight_dt), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
        
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})

test_enrich_list <- lapply(test_enrich_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        gene_ids <- strsplit(weight_dt@result$geneID, "/")
        gene_ids_reg <- lapply(gene_ids, function(x){
            x[x %in% c(spearman_dmr_reg, spearman_histone_reg)]
        })
        weight_dt@result$dmrReg_Ids <- sapply(gene_ids_reg, paste, collapse = "/")
        weight_dt@result$dmrReg_Num <- lengths(gene_ids_reg)
        weight_dt@result$dmrReg_Prc <- lengths(gene_ids_reg)/lengths(gene_ids)
        pairwise_termsim(weight_dt)
    })
})
```

```{r}
factor_cols <- c("Factor_1_weights", "Factor_2_weights")
gsea_vect_list <- lapply(factor_cols, function(x){
    rna_dt <- as.data.frame(rowData(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]))
    fc_vect <- rna_dt[[x]]
    names(fc_vect) <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(rna_dt),
                                 column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
    sort(fc_vect[!is.na(names(fc_vect))], decreasing = TRUE)
})
names(gsea_vect_list) <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

gsea_vect_list$Factor_2 <- sort(gsea_vect_list$Factor_2*-1, decreasing = TRUE)

library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
set.seed(1234)
enrich_list_go_gsea <- lapply(gsea_vect_list, function(factor_dt){
    enrich_res <- gseGO(geneList = factor_dt, 
                        maxGSSize = 500, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                        ont = "BP")
    
    enrich_res <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res = enrich_res,
                                    featureDict = ensembl2entrez,
                                    dt_type = "gsea")
    if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
    enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- enrich_res@result$enrichmentScore
    enrich_res
})

enrich_list_go_gsea_filt <- lapply(enrich_list_go_gsea, function(factor_dt){
    factor_dt <- clusterProfiler::simplify(factor_dt)
    factor_dt <- enrichplot::pairwise_termsim(factor_dt)
    factor_dt
})
enrich_list_go_gsea_filt <- lapply(enrich_list_go_gsea, function(factor_dt){
    factor_dt@result <- factor_dt@result[factor_dt@result$p.adjust <= 0.00000001,]
    factor_dt
})
```

```{r}
    })
```

```{r}
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2FC <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
        enrich_m
```
```{r}
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_dt)
    factor_res
})
```

```{r}
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = weight_dt, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "ALL", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
```

```{r}
        enrich_res
    })
})

metabo_rd <- rowData(multi_omics[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]])


lapply(names(chebi_enrich_list_dmrreg), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt  <- chebi_enrich_list_dmrreg[[factor_id]]
    
    lapply(names(factor_dt), function(weight_id){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
        
        if(!nrow(weight_dt)){return(NULL)}
        chebi_ids <- weight_dt@result$ID[weight_dt@result$p.adjust <= 0.05]
        found_kegg_ids <- term2kegg_filt$kegg_id[match(chebi_ids, term2kegg_filt$term)]
        
        compound_names <- term2name_filt$name[match(chebi_ids, term2name_filt$term)]
        names(compound_names) <- found_kegg_ids
        
        pdf(paste0("../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/", 
                    factor_id, "_", weight_id, "_feat.pdf"))
        
        lapply(found_kegg_ids, function(kegg_id){
            found_features <- multi_omics[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][grep(kegg_id,
                                                                metabo_rd$compounds_kegg_merged),]
            lapply(rownames(found_features), function(feat_id){
                exp_dt <- found_features[feat_id,]
                plot_dt <- data.frame("abundance" = as.numeric(assay(exp_dt)), 
                                    "group" = exp_dt$group)
                p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt) + 
                        geom_boxplot(aes(x = group, y = abundance, 
                                        fill = group)) +    
                        theme_minimal() + 
                        scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict) + 
                        ggtitle(paste(feat_id, compound_names[kegg_id], "\n", 
                                    rowData(exp_dt)$compounds_merged_readable, 
                                    "\n", rowData(exp_dt)$formula, "\n", 
                                    rowData(exp_dt)$str_row_ion)) +
                        xlab("") + ylab("Scaled Abundance")
                print(p1)
                return(NULL)
            })
            return(NULL)
        })
        dev.off()
        return(NULL)
    })
    return(NULL)
})

```

```{r}
    if(is.null(enrich_res) || nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
    enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
    enrich_res
})

microb_dmr_genes_factor_go_enrich <- lapply(list(dmr_regulated_both_sig_gfm_f1_info,
                                                    dmr_regulated_both_sig_gfm_f2_info), function(factor_dt){
    entrez_ids <- rownames(factor_dt)
    
    entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = entrez_ids, 
                         column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
    enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = entrez_ids, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                            keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "ALL",
                            universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
    if(is.null(enrich_res) || nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
    enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
    enrich_res
})
```


```{r}

rna_seq_rd <- rowData(omic_dt@ExperimentList$RNA_Sequencing)

lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    factor_genes <- rownames(rna_seq_rd)[rna_seq_rd[[paste0("Factor_", 
                                                            factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]]
    factor_dmr_reg_genes <- dmr_regulated[dmr_regulated %in% factor_genes]
    
    
    factor_corr_dt <- lapply(factor_dmr_reg_genes, function(gene_id){
        pearson_reg <- gene_dmr_cors_list$pearson[gene_dmr_cors_list$pearson$Var1 == gene_id,]
        spearman_reg <- gene_dmr_cors_list$spearman[gene_dmr_cors_list$spearman$Var1 == gene_id,]
        
        data.frame("Gene ID" = gene_id, 
                    "pearson_pos_DMRs" = sum(pearson_reg$cor > 0),
                   "pearson_neg_DMRs" = sum(pearson_reg$cor < 0),
                   "spearman_pos_DMRs" = sum(spearman_reg$cor > 0),
                   "spearman_neg_DMRs" = sum(spearman_reg$cor < 0),
                   "Gene_factor_weight" = rna_seq_rd[gene_id, paste0("Factor_", factor_id, "_weights")],
                   "Gene_HFD_fc" = rna_seq_rd[gene_id, "HFD-CNT.log2FC"])
    })    
    factor_corr_dt <- do.call(rbind, factor_corr_dt)
    factor_corr_dt$pearson_pos_reg <- ifelse(factor_corr_dt$pearson_pos_DMRs != 0, 
                                             "Positively Regulated", "Non Positively regulated")
    factor_corr_dt$pearson_neg_reg <- ifelse(factor_corr_dt$pearson_neg_DMRs != 0, 
                                             "Negatively Regulated", "Non Negatively regulated")
    factor_corr_dt$spearman_pos_reg <- ifelse(factor_corr_dt$spearman_pos_DMRs != 0, 
                                             "Positively Regulated", "Non Positively regulated")
    factor_corr_dt$spearman_neg_reg <- ifelse(factor_corr_dt$spearman_neg_DMRs != 0, 
                                             "Negatively Regulated", "Non Negatively regulated")
    
    correlation_dir <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(factor_corr_dt)), function(gene_row){
        factor_corr_gene <- factor_corr_dt[gene_row,]
        
        if(factor_corr_gene$Gene_HFD_fc > 0){
            data.frame("Increase_Met" = sum(factor_corr_gene$pearson_pos_DMRs, 
                                            factor_corr_gene$spearman_pos_DMRs), 
                       "Decrease_Met" = sum(factor_corr_gene$pearson_neg_DMRs,
                                            factor_corr_gene$spearman_neg_DMRs))
        } else{
            data.frame("Increase_Met" = sum(factor_corr_gene$pearson_neg_DMRs,
                                            factor_corr_gene$spearman_neg_DMRs), 
                       "Decrease_Met" = sum(factor_corr_gene$pearson_pos_DMRs, 
                                            factor_corr_gene$spearman_pos_DMRs))
        }
    })
    correlation_dir <- do.call(rbind, correlation_dir)
    
    colSums(correlation_dir)
    
    table(factor_corr_dt$Gene_HFD_fc < 0)
    
    hfd_increase <- factor_corr_dt[factor_corr_dt$Gene_HFD_fc > 0,]
    table(hfd_increase$pearson_pos_reg, hfd_increase$pearson_neg_reg)
    
    hfd_decrease <- factor_corr_dt[factor_corr_dt$Gene_HFD_fc < 0,]
    table(hfd_decrease$pearson_pos_reg, hfd_decrease$pearson_neg_reg)
    
    
    table(factor_corr_dt$pearson_pos_reg, factor_corr_dt$pearson_neg_reg)
    table(factor_corr_dt$spearman_pos_reg, factor_corr_dt$spearman_neg_reg)
    
})
```

```{r}
res_overlaps <- lapply(names(nw_plot_list), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_plot_list[[score_id]]
    lapply(names(score_dt), function(factor_id){
        
        plot_dt <- score_dt[[factor_id]] 
        
        gene_ids <- unique(plot_dt$Gene_ID[plot_dt$Same_Gene_bool])
        dmr_ids <- unique(plot_dt$DMR_ID[plot_dt$Same_Gene_bool])
        
        omic_dt_filt <- omic_dt[c(gene_ids, dmr_ids),]
        gene_weights <- rowData(omic_dt_filt@ExperimentList$RNA_Sequencing)[,c("Factor_1_weights", "Factor_2_weights")]
        
        dmr_weights <- rowData(omic_dt_filt@ExperimentList$WGB_DNA_Methylation)[,c("Factor_1_weights", "Factor_2_weights")]
        
        gene_b <- data.frame(Factor_1_b = apply(gene_weights, 1,
                                                 function(x){abs(x[1])/sum(abs(x[1:2]))}),
                             Factor_2_b = apply(gene_weights, 1,
                                                 function(x){abs(x[2])/sum(abs(x))}))
        
        tmax_genes <- table(apply(gene_b, 1, which.max))
        
        t07_genes <- table(apply(gene_b, 1, function(x){
            x_max <- which(x >= 0.7)
            ifelse(length(x_max), x_max, 0)
        }))
        
        dmr_b <- data.frame(Factor_1_b = apply(dmr_weights, 1,
                                                 function(x){abs(x[1])/sum(abs(x[1:2]))}),
                             Factor_2_b = apply(dmr_weights, 1,
                                                 function(x){abs(x[2])/sum(abs(x))}))
        
        tmax_dmrs <- table(apply(dmr_b, 1, which.max))
        
        t07_dmrs <- table(apply(dmr_b, 1, function(x){
            x_max <- which(x >= 0.7)
            ifelse(length(x_max), x_max, 0)
        }))
        
        return(list("Genes" = list("Max" = tmax_genes, 
                                   "X07" = t07_genes), 
                    "DMRs" = list("Max" = tmax_dmrs, 
                                  "X07" = t07_dmrs)))
    })
})
```

### MetaboAnalyst Mummichog analysis

```{r}
library(MetaboAnalystR)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

expr_list <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- paste0("Full_Factor == 'Factor_", factor_id, "'")
    
    list("All Weights" = as.expression(factor_expr),
         "Positive Weights" = as.expression(paste0(factor_expr, " & Factor_", 
                                                   factor_id, "_weights > 0")),
         "Negative Weights" = as.expression(paste0(factor_expr, " & Factor_", 
                                                   factor_id, "_weights < 0")))
})
names(expr_list) <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))

expr_list$Factor_3$`All Weights` <- "Full_Factor == 'Factor_3'"
expr_list$Factor_3$`Positive Weights` <- "Full_Factor == 'Factor_3' & Factor_1_weights > 0"
expr_list$Factor_3$`Negative Weights` <- "Full_Factor == 'Factor_3' & Factor_1_weights < 0"
expr_list
# enrich_exp_list <- lapply(expr_list, function(factor_expr){
#     range_dt <- rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$RNA_Sequencing)
#     lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
#         range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
#                       envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]
#     })
# })

unt_met_dt <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]
    range_dt <- as.data.frame(rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$Untargeted_Metabolomics))
    
    full_dt <- rowData(multi_omics_full[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]])
    
    lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        
        sig_ids <- rownames(range_dt)[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                            envir = as.data.frame(range_dt))]
        
        # feature_dt <- full_dt[,c("mzmed", "rtmed",
        #                         paste0(factor_id, "_weights"))]
        feature_dt <- full_dt[,c("mzmed", "rtmed", "Group_Test.statistic")]
        
        feature_dt$p.value <- ifelse(rownames(full_dt) %in% sig_ids, 0.05, 1)
        
        feature_dt$mode <- tolower(gsub("^.*_", "", gsub("\\..*$", "",
                                                        rownames(feature_dt))))
        # feature_dt <- feature_dt[c("mzmed", "rtmed", paste0(factor_id, "_weights"),
        #                             "p.value", "mode")]
        feature_dt <- feature_dt[c("mzmed", "rtmed", "Group_Test.statistic",
                                    "p.value", "mode")]
        colnames(feature_dt) <- c("mz", "rt", "t.score", "p.value", "mode")
        feature_dt$t.score <- abs(feature_dt$t.score)
        feature_dt
    })
})
names(unt_met_dt) <- names(expr_list)

old_dir <- getwd()
mummichog_dir <- paste0(output_dir, "mummichog_metaboanalyst_full/")
```


```{r}
if(!dir.exists(mummichog_dir)){dir.create(mummichog_dir)}

for(factor_id in names(unt_met_dt)){
    for(weight_id in names(unt_met_dt[[factor_id]])){
        results_output <- paste0(mummichog_dir, factor_id, "_", weight_id, "/")
        if(!dir.exists(results_output)){dir.create(results_output)}
        setwd(results_output)
        write.table(unt_met_dt[[factor_id]][[weight_id]], 
                    row.names = FALSE,
                    file = "./mummichog_dt.txt", sep = ",")

        mSet <- InitDataObjects("mass_all", "mummichog", FALSE)

        mSet <- UpdateInstrumentParameters(mSet, 10.0, "mixed", "yes", 0.05)

        mSet <- Read.PeakListData(mSet, "mummichog_dt.txt")

        mSet <- SetRTincluded(mSet, "seconds")

        mSet <- SanityCheckMummichogData(mSet)

        mSet <- SetPeakEnrichMethod(mSet, "mum", "v2")

        mSet <- SetMummichogPval(mSet, cutoff = 0.05)

        mSet <- PerformPSEA(mSet, "mmu_kegg", "current", 3 , 100)

        mSet<-PlotPeaks2Paths(mSet, "peaks_to_paths_0_", "png", 72, width=NA)
        saveRDS(mSet, file = "./metaboanalyst_obj.rds")
        rm(mSet)
        setwd(old_dir)
    }
}
```

```{r}
enrich_name <- "metabolite_enrich_full"
```

```{r}
full_dt <- rowData(multi_omics_full[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]])
universe_ids <- full_dt[["compounds_kegg_merged"]]
universe_ids <- unlist(strsplit(universe_ids, ";"))
universe_ids <- universe_ids[!is.na(universe_ids)]

set.seed(123)
met_enrich_results <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]
    range_dt <- as.data.frame(rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$Untargeted_Metabolomics))
    
    factor_res <- lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        sig_ids <- range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";"))
        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids)]
        
        enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids, universe = NULL, 
                            pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                            TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "metabolite_id",],
                            TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2FC <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
        enrich_m
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_expr)
    factor_res
})

}
```

```{r}
# enrich_2$type <- "Gene enrich"

lollipop_compare_enrich <- function(enrich_1, enrich_2, 
                                    dt_colors = c("steelblue1", "indianred1")){
    plot_data <- rbind(enrich_1, enrich_2)
    
    if (dim(plot_data)[1] == 0) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    plot_data$Description <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse)", replacement = "", x = plot_data$Description)
    ctrs_dt <- lapply(unique(plot_data$type), function(x) {
        ctrs_dt <- plot_data[plot_data$type == x, ]
        ctrs_dt$Description[order(ctrs_dt$enrich_log2fc, 
            decreasing = TRUE)]
    })
    names(ctrs_dt) <- unique(plot_data$type)
    if (length(ctrs_dt) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    if (length(ctrs_dt) == 1) {
        ctrs_dt[[2]] <- character(0)
        dt_colors[2] <- "white"
    }
    set_1 <- setdiff(ctrs_dt[[2]], ctrs_dt[[1]])
    set_2 <- setdiff(ctrs_dt[[1]], ctrs_dt[[2]])
    set_intersect <- intersect(ctrs_dt[[1]], ctrs_dt[[2]])
    ordered_dt <- c(set_1, set_2, set_intersect)
    
    plot_data$Description_factor <- factor(plot_data$Description, 
        levels = ordered_dt, ordered = TRUE)
    
    color_ctrs <- dt_colors
    names(color_ctrs) <- levels(plot_data$type)

    p_d <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = enrich_log2fc, y = Description_factor)) + 
        geom_point(aes(color = type), size = 8) + 
        geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = enrich_log2fc, y = Description_factor,
                        yend = Description_factor, color = type), 
                    alpha = 0.9, size = 1.5) + 
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0) + 
        geom_text(aes(x = enrich_log2fc, y = Description_factor, 
            label = round(enrich_log2fc, 1)), color = "white", 
            size = 3.25) + theme_minimal() + 
        theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
                axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 16, 
                                                margin = margin(t = 100, b = 100, 
                                                                r = 10, l = 10)),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
              legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
              axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 18),
              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)) + 
        xlab("GSEA Enrich Score") + 
        ylab("KEGG Term Description") + 
        scale_color_manual(name = "Contrasts", values = color_ctrs)
    
    venn_dt <- lapply(unique(plot_data$type), function(x) {
        plot_data$Description_factor[plot_data$type == 
            x]
    })
    names(venn_dt) <- unique(plot_data$type)
    rotation_degree <- ifelse(length(set_1) < length(set_2), 
        180, 0)
    venn_plot <- draw.pairwise.venn(area1 = length(ctrs_dt[[2]]), 
        area2 = length(ctrs_dt[[1]]), cross.area = length(set_intersect), 
        fill = dt_colors, lty = "blank", cex = 0, label.col = c(dt_colors[1], 
            "thistle", dt_colors[2]), rotation.degree = rotation_degree, 
        ind = FALSE)
    plot_grid(p_d, plot_grid(venn_plot, nrow = 8, ncol = 1), 
        rel_widths = c(7, 1))
}
```

### KEGG GSEA Genes + Metabolites

```{r}
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
mg_enrich_exp_list_gsea <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]][1]
    
    lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        met_dt <- range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]
        
        sig_ids_names <- met_dt$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids_names <- strsplit(sig_ids_names, ";")
        
        sig_ids <- met_dt[[paste0(factor_id, "_weights")]]
        sig_ids <- rep(sig_ids, lengths(sig_ids_names))
        names(sig_ids) <- unlist(sig_ids_names)
        
        # sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";"))
        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(names(sig_ids))]
        
        
        gene_dt <- range_dt_g[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(range_dt_g)),]
        sig_ids_g <- gene_dt[[paste0(factor_id, "_weights")]]
        names(sig_ids_g) <- gene_dt$entrezID
        
        # sig_ids_g <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids_g, ";"))
        sig_ids_g <- sig_ids_g[!is.na(names(sig_ids_g))]
        
        sig_ids_merge <- c(sig_ids_g, sig_ids)
        
        sort(sig_ids_merge, decreasing = TRUE)
    })
})

        enrich_res <- GSEA(geneList = weight_dt,
                            TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene, 
                            TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                            maxGSSize = 500)
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- enrich_res@result$enrichmentScore
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        # enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

```{r}
met_gene_enrich_results_gfm_cvm <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]
    
    factor_res <- lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        sig_ids <- range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";"))
        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids)]
        
        sig_ids_g <- range_dt_g[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(range_dt_g)),]$entrezID
        sig_ids_g <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids_g, ";"))
        sig_ids_g <- sig_ids_g[!is.na(sig_ids_g)]
        
        sig_ids_merge <- c(sig_ids_g, sig_ids)
        enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids_merge, universe = NULL, 
                            pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                            TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene,
                            TERM2NAME = kegg_db_list$term2name)
        
        enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res = enrich_m, 
                                        featureDict = c(feature_dict_g,
                                                        feature_dict_met), 
                                        dt_type = "ora")
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
        enrich_m
    })
    factor_res
})
```

```{r}
score_thr <- 0.7

weight_cols <- paste0("Factor_", c("1", "2"), "_weights", 
            c("", "", "_sig", "_sig"))

mofa_prop_abs <- lapply(mofa_w_abs, function(x){
    omic_props <- as.data.frame(t(apply(x, 1, function(x){abs(x)/sum(abs(x))})))
    
    # factor_max <- apply(omic_props, 1, function(x){
    #     found <- which(x >= score_thr)
    #     if(length(found)){return(found)} else{return(0)}
    # })
    max_f_dt <- lapply(omic_props, function(x){
        x >= score_thr
    })
    
    max_f_dt <- do.call(cbind, max_f_dt)
    max_f_dt <- cbind(as.data.frame(x), max_f_dt)
    colnames(max_f_dt) <- weight_cols
    max_f_dt
})

exp_list <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(omic_name){
    omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_name]]
    if(omic_name %in% names(mofa_prop_abs)){
        rowData(omic_exp) <- cbind(rowData(omic_exp), mofa_prop_abs[[omic_name]])
    } else{
        rowData(omic_exp)[weight_cols[1:2]] <- NA
        rowData(omic_exp)[weight_cols[3:4]] <- TRUE    
    }
    omic_exp
})
names(exp_list) <- names(omic_dt)
experiments(omic_dt) <- ExperimentList(exp_list)

network_omics <- list("Pairwise full liver" = omic_combn)
```

### 16S Data

```{r}
pdf(paste0(plot_output_dir, "alpha_diversity_16S.pdf"))
lapply(names(X16S_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- X16S_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]

    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
        
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(x = hierarchy, MARGIN = "samples", method = "relabundance")

    hierarchy <- estimateDiversity(x = hierarchy, index = c("shannon", "log_modulo_skewness"))
    hierarchy <- estimateFaith(x = hierarchy, only.tips = TRUE)
    hierarchy <- estimateRichness(x = hierarchy, index = "observed")
    hierarchy <- estimateEvenness(x = hierarchy, index = "simpson")
    hierarchy <- estimateDominance(x = hierarchy, index = "relative")
    hierarchy <- estimateDivergence(x = hierarchy, reference = "median", FUN = vegan::vegdist)
    
    plots <- lapply(c("observed", "shannon", "simpson", "relative", "log_modulo_skewness", "divergence", "faith"),
            plotColData,
            object = hierarchy,
            x = "group",
            colour_by = "group")
    
    plots <- lapply(plots, "+", 
                    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                          axis.ticks.x = element_blank()))
    
    ((plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) / 
    (plots[[4]] | plots[[5]] | plots[[6]])) /
    (plots[[7]] | plot_spacer() | plot_spacer()) +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(paste(hierarchy_id, "Scores"))  
})
dev.off()
```
