```{r}
library(mia)
library(miaViz)
pdf(paste0(plot_output_dir, "compositions_16S.pdf"))
lapply(names(X16S_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- X16S_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    ## Abundance plots
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts", 
                                method = "relabundance")
    
    # Getting top taxa on a Phylum level
    top_taxa <- getTopFeatures(hierarchy, top = min(nrow(hierarchy), 10), 
                                assay.type = "relabundance")
    
    # Renaming the "Phylum" rank to keep only top taxa and the rest to "Other"
    cat_renamed <- lapply(rownames(hierarchy),
                       function(x){if (x %in% top_taxa) {x} else {"Other"}})
    rowData(hierarchy)[[hierarchy_name]] <- as.character(cat_renamed)
    
    # Visualizing the composition barplot, with samples order by "Bacteroidetes"
    plotAbundance(hierarchy, assay.type="relabundance", rank = hierarchy_name,
                  order_rank_by="abund", 
                  order_sample_by = "group",  add_x_text = TRUE) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
## 16S metagenomics
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
mofa_model <- MOFA2::load_model(file = paste0(output_dir, "model.hdf5"))

factor_dt <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list("dt1" = t(get_factors(mofa_model)$group1)))

x16S_specie_list <- x16S_dt_list[,,grep("Specie",names(x16S_dt_list))]

overlap_samples_list <- lapply(experiments(x16S_specie_list), function(x){
    intersect(colnames(factor_dt), colnames(x))
})
overlap_samples_list

factor_x16S_cors_list <- lapply(names(experiments(x16S_specie_list)), 
                                 function(x16S_exp_name){
    overlap_samples_dt <- overlap_samples_list[[x16S_exp_name]]
    x16S_exp <- x16S_specie_list[[x16S_exp_name]]
    assayNames(x16S_exp) <- "dt1"
    
    corr_res <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
        corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = factor_dt[,overlap_samples_dt], 
                                            experiment2 = x16S_exp[,overlap_samples_dt],
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE)
        corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
        colnames(corr_dt) <- paste("corr.", colnames(corr_dt))
        corr_dt <- corr_dt[corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
        list("Factor_1" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor1",], 
            "Factor_2" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor2",])
    })
    names(corr_res) <- corr_methods
    corr_res
})
names(factor_x16S_cors_list) <- names(experiments(x16S_specie_list))


factor_ids <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

corr_dir <- paste0(output_dir, "correlation_outputs/")
if(!dir.exists(corr_dir)){dir.create(corr_dir)}

for(f_id in factor_ids){
    corr_path <- paste0(corr_dir, f_id, "_x16S_correlations.xlsx")
    wb_chem <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

    for(dt_id in names(factor_x16S_cors_list)){
        
        if(is.null(dt_id)){next}
        
        x16S_dt <- factor_x16S_cors_list[[dt_id]]
        var_ids <- union(x16S_dt$pearson[[f_id]]$Var2, 
                        x16S_dt$spearman[[f_id]]$Var2)
        
        x16S_rd <- rowData(x16s_specie_list[[dt_id]])
        x16S_rd <- x16S_rd[var_ids, colnames(x16S_rd)]
        
        sheet_name <- paste0(strsplit(dt_id, "\\.")[[1]][2:3], collapse = ".")
        
        openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = wb_chem, 
                               sheetName = sheet_name)
        openxlsx::writeData(wb_chem, sheet = sheet_name, 
                            x = as.data.frame(x16S_rd))
            
    }
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb_chem, file = corr_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[!is.na(rowData(hierarchy)[,hierarchy_name])]
    
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(x = hierarchy, MARGIN = "samples", method = "relabundance")

    hierarchy <- estimateDiversity(x = hierarchy, index = c("shannon", "log_modulo_skewness"))
    hierarchy <- estimateFaith(x = hierarchy, only.tips = TRUE)
    hierarchy <- estimateRichness(x = hierarchy, index = "observed")
    hierarchy <- estimateEvenness(x = hierarchy, index = "simpson")
    hierarchy <- estimateDominance(x = hierarchy, index = "relative")
    hierarchy <- estimateDivergence(x = hierarchy, reference = "median", FUN = vegan::vegdist)
    
    plots <- lapply(c("observed", "shannon", "simpson", "relative", "log_modulo_skewness", "divergence", "faith"),
            plotColData,
            object = hierarchy,
            x = "group",
            colour_by = "group")
    
    plots <- lapply(plots, "+", 
                    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                          axis.ticks.x = element_blank()))
    
    ((plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) / 
    (plots[[4]] | plots[[5]] | plots[[6]])) /
    (plots[[7]] | plot_spacer() | plot_spacer()) +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(paste(hierarchy_id, "Scores"))    
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]

    ## Abundance plots
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts", 
                                method = "relabundance")
    
    # Getting top taxa on a Phylum level
    top_taxa <- getTopFeatures(hierarchy, top = 10, assay.type = "relabundance")
    
    # Renaming the "Phylum" rank to keep only top taxa and the rest to "Other"
    cat_renamed <- lapply(rownames(hierarchy),
                       function(x){if (x %in% top_taxa) {x} else {"Other"}})
    rowData(hierarchy)[[hierarchy_name]] <- as.character(cat_renamed)
    
    # Visualizing the composition barplot, with samples order by "Bacteroidetes"
    plotAbundance(hierarchy, assay.type= "relabundance", rank = hierarchy_name,
                  order_rank_by="abund", 
                  order_sample_by = "group",  add_x_text = TRUE) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
## Metagenomics correlations
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
mofa_model <- MOFA2::load_model(file = paste0(output_dir, "model.hdf5"))

factor_dt <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list("dt1" = t(get_factors(mofa_model)$group1)))

shotgun_specie_list <- shotgun_dt_list[,,grep("Specie|Genus",names(shotgun_dt_list))]

shotgun_specie_list_mod <- lapply(names(shotgun_specie_list), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_specie_list[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]  
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    hierarchy
})
names(shotgun_specie_list_mod) <- names(shotgun_specie_list)

experiments(shotgun_specie_list) <- ExperimentList(shotgun_specie_list_mod)

overlap_samples_list <- lapply(experiments(shotgun_specie_list), function(x){
    intersect(colnames(factor_dt), colnames(x))
})
overlap_samples_list

factor_shotgun_cors_list <- lapply(names(experiments(shotgun_specie_list)), 
                                 function(shotgun_exp_name){
    overlap_samples_dt <- overlap_samples_list[[shotgun_exp_name]]
    shotgun_exp <- shotgun_specie_list[[shotgun_exp_name]]
    assayNames(shotgun_exp) <- "dt1"
    
    corr_res <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
        corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = factor_dt[,overlap_samples_dt], 
                                            experiment2 = shotgun_exp[,overlap_samples_dt],
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE)
        corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
        colnames(corr_dt)[3] <- paste(corr_name, colnames(corr_dt)[3])
        corr_dt <- corr_dt[corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
        list("Factor_1" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor1",], 
            "Factor_2" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor2",])
    })
    names(corr_res) <- corr_methods
    corr_res
})
names(factor_shotgun_cors_list) <- names(experiments(shotgun_specie_list))


factor_ids <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

corr_dir <- paste0(output_dir, "correlation_outputs/")
if(!dir.exists(corr_dir)){dir.create(corr_dir)}

for(f_id in factor_ids){
    corr_path <- paste0(corr_dir, f_id, "_shotgun_correlations.xlsx")
    wb_chem <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

    for(dt_id in names(factor_shotgun_cors_list)){
        
        if(is.null(dt_id)){next}
        
        functional_dt <- factor_shotgun_cors_list[[dt_id]]
        var_ids <- union(functional_dt$pearson[[f_id]]$Var2, 
                        functional_dt$spearman[[f_id]]$Var2)
        
        functional_rd <- rowData(shotgun_dt_list[[dt_id]])
        functional_rd <- functional_rd[var_ids, colnames(functional_rd)]
        
        sheet_name <- paste0(strsplit(dt_id, "\\.")[[1]][2:3], collapse = ".")
        
        openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = wb_chem, 
                               sheetName = sheet_name)
        openxlsx::writeData(wb_chem, sheet = sheet_name, 
                            x = as.data.frame(functional_rd))
            
    }
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb_chem, file = corr_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
for(dt_id in names(factor_shotgun_cors_list)){
    if(is.null(dt_id)){next}
    shotgun_dt <- factor_shotgun_cors_list[[dt_id]]
    
    hierarchy_dt_full <- shotgun_specie_list[[dt_id]]
    
    hierarchy_id_all <- unique(sapply(strsplit(rownames(hierarchy_dt_full), ":"),
                                    function(x){x[1]}))
    # hierarchy_id <- strsplit(dt_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    # hierarchy_id <- hierarchy_id[length(hierarchy_id)]
    pdf(paste0("../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/MOFA_Results/sig_int_thr07_paper_met/correlation_outputs/", 
                dt_id, "_dendogram.pdf"))
    for(hierarchy_id in hierarchy_id_all){
        hierarchy_dt <- hierarchy_dt_full[grep(hierarchy_id,
                                            rownames(hierarchy_dt_full)),]
        if(length(hierarchy_dt) <= 1){next}
        hierarchy_dt <- addTaxonomyTree(hierarchy_dt)
        
        tree_dt <- rowTree(hierarchy_dt)
        factor_list_ids <- list()
            
        for(f_id in factor_ids){
            factor_list_ids[[f_id]] <- union(shotgun_dt$pearson[[f_id]]$Var2, 
                                    shotgun_dt$spearman[[f_id]]$Var2)
        }    
            
        tip_colors <- sapply(tree_dt$tip.label, function(x){
            if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_1"]]){
                if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
                    return("purple1") # both factors
                } 
                return("royalblue1")
            } else if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
                return("orange1")
            } else{
                return("black")        
            }
        })
        
        node_colors <- sapply(tree_dt$node.label, function(x){
            if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_1"]]){
                if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
                    return("purple1") # both factors
                } 
                return("royalblue1")
            } else if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
                return("orange1")
            } else{
                return("black")        
            }
        })
        
        plot.phylo(tree_dt, show.node.label = FALSE, tip.color = tip_colors)
    }
    dev.off()
    
}
```

```{r}
shotgun_merged_list <- lapply(c("cecum", "colon"), function(organ_id){
    shotgun_organ_list <- multi_omics_full[,,grepl(organ_id, names(multi_omics_full)) &
                                               grepl("Shotgun", names(multi_omics_full)) &
                                               !grepl("Functional", names(multi_omics_full))] 
    hierarchy_ids <- strsplit(names(shotgun_organ_list), "\\.")
    hierarchy_ids <- sapply(hierarchy_ids, function(x){x[length(x)]})
    
    filtered_hierarchy <- lapply(hierarchy_ids, function(id){
        hierarchy <- shotgun_organ_list[[grep(id, names(shotgun_organ_list))]]
        hierarchy <- hierarchy[grep(id, rownames(hierarchy)),]
        hierarchy
    })
    merged_dt <- Reduce(combineRows, filtered_hierarchy)
    assay(merged_dt) <- as.matrix(assay(merged_dt))
    merged_dt
})
```

```{r}
                    metadata = colData(hierarchy),
                    stratificationVar = "group", plot_name = hierarchy_id,
                    color_vect = group_color_dict) + theme_minimal()
    p1
})
```

```{r}
overlap_samples_list
factor_functional_cors_list <- lapply(names(experiments(shotgun_ft_list)), 
                                 function(shotgun_exp_name){
    overlap_samples_dt <- overlap_samples_list[[shotgun_exp_name]]
    shotgun_exp <- shotgun_ft_list[[shotgun_exp_name]]
    assayNames(shotgun_exp) <- "dt1"
    
    if(!nrow(shotgun_exp)){return(NULL)}
    corr_res <- lapply(corr_methods, function(corr_name){
        corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = factor_dt[,overlap_samples_dt], 
                                            experiment2 = shotgun_exp[,overlap_samples_dt],
                                            method = corr_name,
                                            assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                            assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                            test_significance =  TRUE)
        corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
        colnames(corr_dt) <- paste("corr.", colnames(corr_dt))
        corr_dt <- corr_dt[corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
        list("Factor_1" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor1",], 
            "Factor_2" = corr_dt[corr_dt$Var1 == "Factor2",])
    })
    names(corr_res) <- corr_methods
    corr_res
})
names(factor_functional_cors_list) <- names(experiments(shotgun_ft_list))


factor_ids <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

corr_dir <- paste0(output_dir, "correlation_outputs/")
if(!dir.exists(corr_dir)){dir.create(corr_dir)}

for(f_id in factor_ids){
    corr_path <- paste0(corr_dir, f_id, "_functional_correlations.xlsx")
    wb_chem <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

    for(dt_id in names(factor_functional_cors_list)){
        
        if(is.null(dt_id)){next}
        
        functional_dt <- factor_functional_cors_list[[dt_id]]
        var_ids <- union(functional_dt$pearson[[f_id]]$Var2, 
                        functional_dt$spearman[[f_id]]$Var2)
        
        functional_rd <- rowData(shotgun_ft_dt_list[[dt_id]])
        functional_rd <- functional_rd[var_ids, rev(colnames(functional_rd))]
        
        sheet_name <- paste0(strsplit(dt_id, "\\.")[[1]][2:3], collapse = ".")
        
        openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = wb_chem, 
                               sheetName = sheet_name)
        openxlsx::writeData(wb_chem, sheet = sheet_name, 
                            x = as.data.frame(functional_rd))
            
    }
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb_chem, file = corr_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# shotgun_ft_list_filt <- shotgun_ft_list[,,grepl("colon.metaerg",
#                                             names(shotgun_ft_list))]

other_omic_list <- multi_omics[,,grepl("Shotgun.*colon.Species|Shotgun.*colon.Genus|Metallomics.liver|colon.metaerg",
                                       names(multi_omics))]
other_omic_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]] <- other_omic_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]][grep("Genus",
                                                                                                                     rownames(other_omic_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]]))]
other_omic_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Species"]] <- other_omic_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Species"]][grep("Species",
                                                                                                                     rownames(other_omic_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Species"]]))]

corr_method <- "pearson"

factor_res_list_p <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2"), function(factor_id){
    
    filt_omics <- lapply(experiments(omic_dt)[c("RNA_Sequencing", 
                                                "Untargeted_Metabolomics")],
                        function(omic_exp){
        omic_exp[rowData(omic_exp)[[paste0(factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]]
    })
    
    filt_omics_res <- lapply(names(filt_omics), function(factor_omic_id){
        
        other_res <- lapply(names(other_omic_list), function(other_omic_id){
            factor_omic_dt <- filt_omics[[factor_omic_id]]
            other_omic_dt <- other_omic_list[[other_omic_id]]
            
            overlap_samples_dt <- intersect(colnames(factor_omic_dt), 
                                            colnames(other_omic_dt))
            
            assayNames(factor_omic_dt) <- "dt1"
            assayNames(other_omic_dt) <- "dt1"
            
            corr_dt <- mia::getExperimentCrossCorrelation(x = factor_omic_dt[,overlap_samples_dt], 
                                                    experiment2 = other_omic_dt[,overlap_samples_dt],
                                                    method = corr_method,
                                                    assay.type1 = "dt1", 
                                                    assay.type2 = "dt1",
                                                    test_significance =  TRUE)
            # corr_dt$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_dt$pval, method = "fdr")
            # colnames(corr_dt)[3] <- paste0(corr_name, ".", colnames(corr_dt)[3])
            # corr_dt <- corr_dt[corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
            corr_dt$Var1_omic <- factor_omic_id
            corr_dt$Var2_omic <- other_omic_id
            corr_dt
        })
        do.call(rbind, other_res)
    })
    factor_res <- do.call(rbind, filt_omics_res)
    factor_res$p_adj <- p.adjust(factor_res$pval, "fdr")
    factor_res
})
names(factor_res_list_p) <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

factor_res_list_p <- lapply(factor_res_list_p, function(factor_dt){
    factor_dt[factor_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})
```

```{r}
variables_dicts <- lapply(unique(names(multi_omics)), function(omic_name){
    if(omic_name == "RNA_Sequencing"){
        return("gene_lab")
    } else if(omic_name == "Untargeted_Metabolomics"){
        return("compounds_merged_readable")
        #return("HFD-CNT.formula")
    } else if(grepl("DNA_Methylation", omic_name)){
        return("geneName")
    } else if(grepl("Shotgun.*Functional", omic_name)){
        return("Description")  
    } else if(grepl("Shotgun|Metallomics|16S|Targeted|Histone", omic_name)){
        return(NA)  
    } else{
        return(NA)
    }
})
names(variables_dicts) <- unique(names(multi_omics))
```

```{r}
kept_correlations <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2"), function(factor_id){
     
    # Gene ids associated to KEGG ids
    test_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(met_gene_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    
    names(test_genes) <- as.data.frame(met_gene_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description
    test_genes_df <- lapply(names(test_genes), function(x){
        data.frame("term" = x, "vars" = test_genes[[x]])})
    test_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, test_genes_df)
    
    # Number of KEGG pathways associated with each gene
    gene_var_list <- lapply(unique(test_genes_df$vars), function(var_id){
        test_genes_df$term[test_genes_df$vars == var_id]
    })
    names(gene_var_list) <- unique(test_genes_df$vars)
    
    # gene_var_list_unique <- unlist(gene_var_list[lengths(gene_var_list) == 1])
    # 
    # Factor correlation with other omics
    cor_factor <- factor_res_list_p[[factor_id]]
    gene_corr_list <- lapply(levels(cor_factor$Var1), function(x){
        cor_factor[as.character(cor_factor$Var1) == x,]
    })
    names(gene_corr_list) <- levels(cor_factor$Var1)
    
    gene_corr_list_dup <- lapply(names(gene_var_list), function(gene_id){
        pathway_ids <- gene_var_list[[gene_id]]
        pathway_dups <- lapply(pathway_ids, function(pathway_id){
            gene_corr <- gene_corr_list[[gene_id]] 
            if(is.null(gene_corr) || !nrow(gene_corr)){return(NULL)}
            gene_corr$Var1_term <- pathway_id
            gene_corr
        })
        do.call(rbind, pathway_dups)
    })
    found_factor <- do.call(rbind, gene_corr_list_dup)
    
    found_factor <- found_factor[!is.na(found_factor$Var1_term),]
    # found_factor <- found_factor[found_factor$Var2 %in%
    #                                 names(table(found_factor$Var2) > 1),]
    
    found_factor <- found_factor[order(found_factor$cor),]
    found_factor <- found_factor[abs(found_factor$cor) > 0.8,]
    ## Correlation color palette
    
    # found_factor$Var2 <- readable_var_names[as.character(found_factor$Var2)]
    # found_factor$Var2 <- gsub("Genus:|Species:", "", found_factor$Var2)
    # names(var_color_merge) <- gsub("Genus:|Species:", "", names(var_color_merge))
    return(found_factor)
    lapply(unique(found_factor$Var2_omic), function(other_omic_id){
        test <- found_factor[found_factor$Var2_omic == other_omic_id,]
        
        corr_colors <- ifelse(test$cor > 0,
                          paired_palette[3], paired_palette[1])
        corr_colors[test$cor > 0 & test$Var1 %in% dmr_regulated] <- paired_palette[4]
        corr_colors[test$cor < 0 & test$Var1 %in% dmr_regulated] <- paired_palette[2]
        
        test_2 <- data.frame("Omic1" = test$Var1_term, 
                            "Omic2" = test$Var2)
    
        test_2$Omic1 <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", test_2$Omic1)
        test_2$Omic2 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_2$Omic2)]
        
        ordered_vars <- c(names(kegg_colors)[names(kegg_colors) %in% unique(test_2$Omic1)],
                        readable_var_names[names(omic_var_dict)])
    
        ## correlation palette
        # corr_color_idx <- cut(found_factor$cor, breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 21))
        # corr_col_seq <- ramp_pal(102)
        # corr_color_vector <- corr_col_seq[corr_color_idx]
    
        dmr_reg_cor <- found_factor$Var1 %in% dmr_regulated 
        
        # term_vars <- rep("Term", length(unique(test_2$Omic1)))
        # names(term_vars) <- unique(test_2$Omic1)
        # return(test_2)
        # ordered_vars <- c(term_vars, omic_var_dict)
        svg(paste0("../../outputs/Paper_Figures/term_chord_", factor_id, "_", 
                    other_omic_id, "_pearson.svg"), 
            width = 20, height = 20)
        
        # layout(matrix(1:2,ncol=2), width = c(2,0.5), height = c(1,0.5))
```

```{r}
test_db_ids <- strsplit(met_gene_enrich_results$Factor_1$`All Weights`@result$geneID, "/")
names(test_db_ids) <- met_gene_enrich_results$Factor_1$`All Weights`@result$Description

pathway_dist_filt <- matrix(nrow = length(test_db_ids), 
                            ncol = length(test_db_ids))

for(x in seq_along(test_db_ids)){
    for(y in seq_along(test_db_ids)){
        pathway_dist_filt[x, y] <- length(intersect(test_db_ids[[x]],
                                                test_db_ids[[y]]))/length(union(test_db_ids[[x]], test_db_ids[[y]]))    
    }
}
pathway_dist_filt <- 1 - pathway_dist_filt
colnames(pathway_dist_filt) <- names(test_db_ids)
rownames(pathway_dist_filt) <- names(test_db_ids)
```

```{r}
# network_omics <- list("All Omics" = names(assays(omic_dt)))
variables_dicts <- lapply(unique(unlist(network_omics[[1]])), function(omic_name){
    if(omic_name == "RNA_Sequencing"){
        return("gene_lab")
    } else if(omic_name == "Untargeted_Metabolomics"){
        return("compounds_merged_readable")
        #return("HFD-CNT.formula")
    } else if(grepl("DNA_Methylation", omic_name)){
        return("geneName")
    } else if(grepl("Shotgun|Metallomics|16S|Targeted|Histone", omic_name)){
        return("readable_name")  
    } else{
        return(NA)
    }
})
names(variables_dicts) <- unique(unlist(network_omics[[1]]))
variables_dicts[is.na(variables_dicts)] <- NULL

# corr_method_vect <- c("kendall", "spearman", "pearson")

for(corr_method in corr_method_vect){
    xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render,
                            args = list(input = "../Multi_Omics_Correlations/Correlations_Script.Rmd",
                              output_file = params$output_dir,
                              params = list(
                                corr_threshold = 0,
                                corr_method = corr_method,
                                multi_omic_path = multi_omics,
                                group_metadata_var = "group",
                                sample_levels_2_correlate = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT"),
                                filter_variable_2_correlate = list(
                                    "All" = NA
                                ),
                                p_adj_thr = 1,
                                omic_list_pairs = network_omics,
                                rowData_variable_name_list = variables_dicts,
                                draw_networks = FALSE,
                                draw_cytoscape = FALSE,
                                add_autocorrelations = FALSE,
                                keep_full_correlations = TRUE,
                                output_dir = corr_output_dir,
                                output_suffix = paste0("0_005_chi_f1f2_", corr_method),
                                add_variables = TRUE,
                                variables_names = add_var_names,
                                draw_cluster_scatter_plots = FALSE))
     )
}
```

#### No filter

```{r}
lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        graph_weights <- edge_attr(graph_dt,
                        name = "weight")
        
        hist(graph_weights)
        prop.table(table(graph_weights > 0))
    })
})
```

#### Significant filter

```{r}
nw_graphs <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        graph_weights <- abs(edge_attr(graph_dt,
                        name = "weight"))
        graph_adj.p.val <- edge_attr(graph_dt, name = "adj.p.value")
        # subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
        #             E(graph_dt)[graph_weights >= score_filters[score_id] & graph_adj.p.val <= 0.05],
        #             delete.vertices = FALSE)
        subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
                    E(graph_dt)[graph_adj.p.val <= 0.05],
                    delete.vertices = FALSE)
    })
    names(score_res) <- names(score_dt)
    score_res
})
names(nw_graphs) <- score_names
```

```{r}
tf_db <- read.table("../../inputs/RNA_Sequencing/export_tfcheckpoint.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

                        column = "ENSEMBL", keytype = "ENTREZID", 
                        multiVals = "first")
nw_ids_tfs <- paste0("RNA_Sequencing.", mouse_tf_ensembl)

nw_graphs_tfs <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        nw_dt <- as_long_data_frame(graph_dt)
        nw_dt[nw_dt$from_name %in% nw_ids_tfs | 
                nw_dt$to_name %in% nw_ids_tfs,]
    })
    names(score_res) <- names(score_dt)
    score_res
})
names(nw_graphs) <- score_names
```     

```{r}
nw_plot_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(factor_dt){
        test <- igraph::as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)
        rna_dna_omics <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "Histone_Modifications_Proteomics")
        rna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt,
                                                    name = "Node_Omic") == rna_omic_id]
        dna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, 
                                                    name = "Node_Omic") == dna_omic_id]
        test_dna_rna <- test[(test$to_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics) &
                                 (test$from_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics),]
        gene_col <- ifelse(test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == rna_omic_id,
        "to_name", "from_name")
        gene_node <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(test_dna_rna)),
                            function(x){test_dna_rna[x,gene_col[x]]})
        gene_id <- gsub(paste0(rna_omic_id, "."), "", gene_node)
        dmr_col <- ifelse(test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == dna_omic_id,
                        "to_name", "from_name")
        dmr_node <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(test_dna_rna)),
                        function(x){test_dna_rna[x,dmr_col[x]]})
        dmr_id <- gsub(paste0(dna_omic_id, "."), "", dmr_node)
        nw_dt <- data.frame("Histone_node" = dmr_node, "Gene_node" = gene_node,
                            "Histone_ID" = dmr_id, "Gene_ID" = gene_id,
                            "Histone_omic" = dna_omic_id, 
                            "Gene_omic" = rna_omic_id,
                            "weight" = test_dna_rna[["weight"]])
        nw_dt$Gene_chromosome <- ids_to_map[nw_dt$Gene_ID, "chromosome_name"]
        nw_dt
    })
})
```

```{r}
pdf(paste0(corr_output_dir, "Histone_RNA_correlations_sig_unique_pn.pdf"))
lapply(names(plot_list), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- plot_list[[score_id]]
        lapply(names(score_dt), function(factor_id){
        plot_dt <- score_dt[[factor_id]]
        line_dt <- plot_dt %>% group_by(omic) %>%
            summarise(mean_dt = mean(value), median_dt = median(value))
        rna_seq_dt <- plot_dt[plot_dt$omic == "Liver RNA Sequencing",]
            unique_order <- sapply(unique(rna_seq_dt$name), function(x){
            corr_val <- rna_seq_dt$value[rna_seq_dt$name == x]
            corr_val <- corr_val[corr_val < 0]
            ifelse(length(corr_val), corr_val, 0)
        })
        rna_seq_dt$name <- factor(rna_seq_dt$name, 
                                names(sort(unique_order, 
                                            decreasing = TRUE)))
        rna_seq_dt$color_c <- ifelse(rna_seq_dt$value < 0, "royalblue", "red")
        dna_seq_dt <- plot_dt[plot_dt$omic == "Liver Histone Modifications",]
        unique_order <- sapply(unique(dna_seq_dt$name), function(x){
            corr_val <- dna_seq_dt$value[dna_seq_dt$name == x]
            corr_val <- corr_val[corr_val < 0]
            ifelse(length(corr_val), corr_val, 0)
        })
        dna_seq_dt$name <- factor(dna_seq_dt$name, 
                                names(sort(unique_order, decreasing = TRUE)))
        dna_seq_dt$color_c <- ifelse(dna_seq_dt$value < 0, "royalblue", "red")
        
        levels(dna_seq_dt$name) <- gsub(paste0(dna_omic_id, "."), 
                                        "", levels(dna_seq_dt$name))
        
        p1 <- ggplot(rna_seq_dt) +
            geom_col(aes(x = value, y = name, fill = color_c)) +
            geom_text(aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = n_vars), 
                    hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
            xlab("Negative/Positive correlations") + ylab("Unique gene") +
            ggtitle(paste(score_id, factor_id, "Histone-RNA correlations")) +
            geom_vline(xintercept = 0)
        
        p2 <- ggplot(dna_seq_dt) +
            geom_col(aes(x = value, y = name, fill = color_c)) +
            geom_text(aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = n_vars), 
                      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none") +
            xlab("Negative/Positive correlations") + ylab("Unique Histone") +
            ggtitle(paste(score_id, factor_id, "Histone-RNA correlations")) +
            geom_vline(xintercept = 0)
        sapply(list(p1, p2), print)
    })
})
dev.off()
```

#### Weight filter

```{r}
nw_graphs <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        graph_weights <- abs(edge_attr(graph_dt,
                        name = "weight"))
        graph_adj.p.val <- edge_attr(graph_dt, name = "adj.p.value")
        subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
                    E(graph_dt)[graph_weights >= score_filters[score_id]],
                    delete.vertices = FALSE)
        # subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
        #             E(graph_dt)[graph_adj.p.val <= 0.05],
        #             delete.vertices = FALSE)
    })
    names(score_res) <- names(score_dt)
    score_res
})
names(nw_graphs) <- score_names
```

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    
    lapply(score_dt, function(factor_dt){
    
        test <- igraph::as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)
        rna_dna_omics <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
        
        
        rna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic") == rna_omic_id]
        dna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic") == dna_omic_id]
        
        test_dna_rna <- test[(test$to_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics) & 
                 (test$from_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics),]
        
        rna_seq_corr <- c(test_dna_rna$to_name[test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == rna_omic_id],
                          test_dna_rna$from_name[test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic == rna_omic_id])
        dna_seq_corr <- c(test_dna_rna$to_name[test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == dna_omic_id],
                          test_dna_rna$from_name[test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic == dna_omic_id])
        
        
        rna_table <- table(rna_seq_corr)
        dna_table <- table(dna_seq_corr)
        
        
        rna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(rna_table),
                                   "value_perc" = as.numeric(rna_table)/length(dna_nodes),
                                    "name" = names(rna_table),
                                    "omic" = "RNA_Sequencing",
                                    "n_vars" = paste("Nt = ", length(rna_nodes),
                                                     "/ N = ", length(rna_table))
                                )
        
        dna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(dna_table),
                                    "value_perc" = as.numeric(dna_table)/length(rna_nodes),
                                    "name" = names(dna_table),
                                    "omic" = "WGB_DNA_Methylation",
                                    "n_vars" = paste("Nt =", length(dna_nodes),
                                                     "/ N = ", length(dna_table))
                                   )
        count_merged_dt <- rbind(rna_count_dt, dna_count_dt)
        
        count_merged_dt$omic <- omic_names_dict[as.character(count_merged_dt$omic)]
        count_merged_dt
    })
})

```

What we see makes sense as we have smaller differences in DNA methylation data than in RNA-Seq data, from 602 significant DMRs to around ~10000 significant genes.
